catalog_principles: Register first; provider declarations second; third parties only as pointers.
Keep legal entity, brand, product issuer, underwriter, distributor and custodian separate.
Every product fact requires a URL, retrieval date and supporting quotation or structured-feed field.
List pricing and quote-dependent pricing are distinct.
Missing or conflicting fields remain null and are recorded as gaps.
The catalog contains facts; person-specific ranking and recommendations occur downstream.

confidence_rules.rule: A structured provider/government product feed was used, or two independent first-party artifacts agree on the extracted fact.
The fact is supported by one first-party provider or mandated disclosure source and no conflicting primary source was found.
The source is inaccessible, ambiguous, stale, conflicts with another primary source, or does not clearly support the mapped fact.

derived_from.title: Australia and Canada retail financial-products master research roadmap

scope_exclusions: Employer-only pensions, group benefits and workplace schemes that an individual cannot select on the open market.
Government benefits, grants and direct government loan programs; government rules may still be decision evidence.
Individual securities or issuer capital raisings such as ordinary shares, single-company bonds and crowdfunding offerings.
Pure professional services such as advisers and mortgage brokers, except where they identify a regulated provider, issuer or distribution channel.
Utilities, telecommunications products, retail warranties and non-financial memberships.
Niche add-ons unless marketed as a standalone retail financial or insurance product.
Closed legacy products unless required for a coverage, migration or historical comparison.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Regulator register or official government list
url_requirements.reason: Proves the legal entity’s authorization or registration for the vertical.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Must resolve to the legal entity, identifier, category/status and jurisdiction; never substitute a brand homepage.

url_requirements.example_source_type: CSV, XLSX, XML, JSON API or regulator download
url_requirements.reason: Supports coverage counts, reproducibility and complete provider enumeration.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Record data date, download timestamp, row count and filters; reconcile live-status changes.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Provider’s official corporate or consumer site
url_requirements.reason: Connects the registered legal entity to its current consumer-facing identity.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Capture legal-name/footer disclosure and any stated trading names; do not infer group ownership.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Website footer, legal disclosure, product issuer statement
url_requirements.reason: Prevents products being assigned to the wrong legal issuer or underwriting entity.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Quote the exact issuer/underwriter/distributor relationship and effective date if stated.
Store request version, required headers, query parameters, pagination and raw response timestamp.

url_requirements.reason: Provides product-level pricing, eligibility, features and constraints.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Retain immutable product ID and raw payload; map only fields actually returned.

url_requirements.example_source_type: PDS, prospectus, Fund Facts, ETF Facts, PHIS, key facts sheet, policy wording
url_requirements.reason: Primary source for contractual product terms, risks, exclusions and conditions.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Record document title, version/effective date, issuer, retrieval date and relevant page/table.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Australian Target Market Determination or equivalent suitability disclosure
url_requirements.reason: Captures intended customer, distribution conditions and negative target market.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Do not treat broad marketing language as a formal target-market document.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Rate sheet, fee schedule, premium table, commission schedule
url_requirements.reason: Supports point-in-time list pricing and fee extraction.
url_requirements.url_type: Current rates, fees or premium schedule
url_requirements.validation_rule: Record effective date and conditions; distinguish list price from personalized quote.

url_requirements.reason: Provides current product name, marketing status, features and navigation to formal documents.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Use product-page facts only when the page states them; prefer formal documents for conflicts.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Eligibility page, application checklist, underwriting guide
url_requirements.reason: Supports screening before ranking products for a person.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Capture residency, age, income, asset, property, employment, health and channel restrictions only as stated.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Official quote engine, calculator or pre-qualification tool
url_requirements.reason: Identifies pricing inputs and whether price is list-based or personalized.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Never convert a hypothetical calculator output into a universal product price; record the input scenario.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Account terms, cardholder agreement, loan contract, policy contract
url_requirements.reason: Supports cancellation, renewal, repayment, redemption, default, claims and complaint terms.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Capture document version and precedence clauses; do not rely on a marketing FAQ for contractual exclusions.

url_requirements.example_source_type: FCS, CDIC, provincial deposit insurer, Assuris, PACICC
url_requirements.reason: Shows whether deposits, investments or policies receive statutory or industry protection.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Map protection to the legal issuer and aggregation category, not merely the brand.

url_requirements.example_source_type: AFCA, OBSI, GIO or regulator complaint route
url_requirements.reason: Identifies the external dispute-resolution route available to the consumer.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Use as service/remedy evidence only; it is not licensing or product evidence.

url_requirements.example_source_type: AFCA data, regulator enforcement notices, ombudsman reports
url_requirements.reason: Adds decision context about disputes, sanctions and recurring issues.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Normalize for provider scale when possible and never infer product quality from raw complaint counts alone.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Official locator, network list, service standards or mobile-app support page
url_requirements.reason: Supports decisions involving branches, ATMs, advisers, repair networks, healthcare providers or claims channels.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Record geographic coverage, accessibility and channel restrictions with retrieval date.

url_requirements.example_source_type: Fund performance report, super performance data, bonus history, claims statistics
url_requirements.reason: Provides historical outcomes where they are decision-relevant.
url_requirements.validation_rule: Retain period, benchmark, calculation basis and warnings; never present past performance as a forecast.
